notes.title: Blood Impact Demo is OUT for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest starts now, so [b]Blood Impact Demo is OUT![/b] 
It is very short (5 min), where you can [b]try the gameplay mechanics![/b]
This demo is the [b]first foundation stone[/b] of the [b]Early Access for November 2021![/b]

Challenge: [b]Will you finish it with blood?[/b]

I made also a [b]survey to collect your opinions[/b]: https://forms.gle/K1yFKxJbAr8MYqEW7
So [b]your feedback will be very important and useful![/b]
